0022600141.text: The Jazz (1-2, 1-1 at home) host the Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home) in Utah's fifth game of the 2026-27 season. Utah is 5th in the Northwest and 11th in the West, while San Antonio is 4th in the Southwest and 10th in the West, with the Spurs on a one-game winning streak and the Jazz coming off a loss. Utah will be without Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Jazz lost the season series 1-2, including a 126-109 loss in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026.
